title: DaVinci MIQRO Pearl and Gasket
description: The Davinci MIQRO Pearl and Gasket set serves as replacement pieces for the oven reducer of your MIQRO. The Pearl and gasket are made from high quality material that doesn’t tarnish the taste or quality of your herbs. Take the gasket and wiggle it into place and then screw on the Pearl to your desired level.
